title: Abuse report body
description: A report by a third party (a site or a person an agent harmed) that has no passport here (register row H3; spec-delta S430). The issuer is the reporter's own did:web identity; it signs with the key it names in reporter_key, which the record's signature must use. proof is the SHA-256 of the DID document the reporter's domain publishes (the url is the one did:web gives), so the key is shown to be the domain's: the operator fetches that document at admission, checks that it publishes reporter_key and that its hash is proof.sha256, and countersigns; the log requires the operator's countersignature, so the check is attributable and replay stays offline. The accused is an agent with a passport. A reporter files at most 5 reports a day and one per accused a week. The report is a lead for the Registry and the Courts and has no automatic effect. Chain: none (prev is null).

about.description: A record of the accused that shows the harm (an Action, a contract), if the reporter knows one.

public_key.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, base64url without padding.
